strict_delta.real_algebra: For positive finite p,g, max(p/g,g/p)<1.25 iff p<1.25*g and g<1.25*p
strict_delta.floating_boundary_artificial_scan: Generated all raw uint16 values 1..65535; each raw/5000 float64 g, cast threshold1.25*g and g/1.25 to FP32, plus adjacent representable FP32 on either side
strict_delta.not_a_claim: This is synthetic boundary validation, not actual data scoring or a general real-arithmetic proof for arbitrary dtypes/scales

verified.baseline_flow: Within explicit mode loop all four current receipts/seals/NPZ hashes are checked before explicit GT loop. Prediction-invalid pixels on valid GT remain in delta denominator; any such pixel nulls frame AbsRel/RMSE. uint16 GT makes g>0 equivalent to finite-positive.

required_corrections.location: main first contract identities hash loop, parent read
required_corrections.problem: The contract currently accepts an arbitrary identity map. It neither requires parent/self binding nor prohibits a sensor-GT path, so all4-seal-before-any-GT is not a guarantee of the entry point. At inspection contract.json did not exist, so no safe external field restriction was available to inherit.
required_corrections.fix: Constrain contract identities to explicit allowed control paths and require parent+self entries before hashing any listed path; root must freeze actual values. Do not place sensor/output payload files in this initial identity set.

required_corrections.problem: The review hashes the current producer receipts/seals/NPZs but does not require them to match the original scoring PASS input_sha256_before_after. A current self-consistent replacement set under the same parent could be recomputed instead of the precise set scored.
required_corrections.fix: Before GT, require all current producer identity entries to equal the original score receipt input map; bind the original metrics parent/domain and the common recovery output chain. Preserve the narrow IMPORT_VALIDATED label.

required_corrections.problem: Only three depth means are recomputed. Original aggregate also has prediction_invalid_fraction_on_gt mean; count/frame/defined metadata and method-key completeness are not checked. Iterating only existing metrics keys can silently omit a missing group.
required_corrections.fix: Assert 28 unique per-frame mode/index rows; exact method sets for new4/all8/old4; check the fourth invalid-fraction mean and relevant fixed frame counts/defined counts, or explicitly narrow any report saying all group means. Prefer include all originally reported denominators/count sums.

required_corrections.problem: common_old checks validation_status and zero new_GA but does not retain producer_kind, recovery link, historical gaps or unchanged originalFAILED status in the review receipt.
required_corrections.fix: Carry the explicitly inherited IMPORT_VALIDATED scope and historical missing observations into the final receipt; do not treat the fourth output as a fourth newly executed GA.

nonblocking_observation: Assertions currently create no failure receipt; a failed run can leave input_seal without receipt and a repeat would overwrite it. Either a root caller must preserve first-attempt artifacts or add fail-closed attempt bookkeeping before execution. No actual run has failed in this review.
next_gate: Root edits only its new recompute.py, preserves this review, then reviewer rechecks changed source SHA. No original scoring code/data changes.
